english:
Dealing Sword damage consumes an Armor Charge to grant Argent Blade for 5 seconds.

Argent Blade grants 15% increased Sword Damage and 100 Charge Rate, and stacks with other buffs.

No additional Armor Charges are consumed while Argent Blade is active.
